info.title: zirv-flow API
info.description: HTTP API of the zirv-flow server.

get.summary: Job counts by kind and state, and how long the oldest runnable job has waited.

403.description: Not the instance owner, or an API key

get.summary: Dead jobs, newest first, without their payloads.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before of the previous page

400.description: limit is out of range or before is malformed

403.description: Not the instance owner, or an API key

post.summary: Puts a dead job back in the queue, to run again now under its original trace.
post.description:
Resets its attempts and clears its error. Audited as `job.retried`; a workspace job also
gets a `job.retry` decision record in its trace.

403.description: Not the instance owner, an API key, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such job, or it is not dead

409.description: An equivalent job is already queued

get.summary: The signed-in user and their CSRF token.

403.description: An API key cannot use this endpoint

post.summary: Signs in with an e-mail and password and starts a session.
post.description:
Sets the `zf_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). An unknown e-mail, a wrong
password and a locked account all give the same 401. Five failures in a row lock the
account for a growing time, up to 15 minutes.

delete.summary: Signs out: ends the session and clears the cookie. Needs the CSRF token.

403.description: Missing or invalid CSRF token

get.summary: Which sign-in methods this instance accepts, for the sign-in screen.

Finishes an OIDC sign-in: the identity provider sends the browser here with `code` and
`state`.
get.description:
On success redirects to the server's public URL with the `zf_session` cookie set. Any
failure is the same 401, and clears the `zf_oidc_state` cookie.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the identity provider when it refused

303.description: Signed in; redirect to the server's public URL, sets the zf_session cookie

get.summary: Starts an OIDC sign-in: redirects the browser to the identity provider.
get.description: Sets the `zf_oidc_state` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) that the callback needs.

303.description: Redirect to the identity provider; sets the zf_oidc_state cookie

503.description: The identity provider cannot be reached

get.summary: Whether the instance still needs its first-run setup.

post.summary: Creates the instance owner and signs them in.
post.description:
Needs the setup token that `serve` logs while no owner exists. Answers like sign-in:
it sets the `zf_session` cookie and returns the user with the CSRF token. An existing
owner is 409, checked before the token; a missing or wrong token is 403.

200.description: The owner was created and signed in

403.description: Missing or wrong setup token
Not the owner, or an API key

post.summary: Creates a user. Owner only. Needs the CSRF token.

403.description: Not the owner, an API key, or a missing CSRF token

409.description: The email is already in use

get.summary: The workspaces the caller can see: all of them for the owner, otherwise their memberships.

403.description: An API key cannot use this endpoint

post.summary: Creates a workspace. Owner only. Needs the CSRF token.

403.description: Not the owner, an API key, or a missing CSRF token

get.summary: One workspace. A caller with no access gets 404, never 403.

403.description: The API key lacks the read scope

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

get.summary:
The keys of a workspace, never including secrets. Workspace admins, the owner and
`admin` keys only.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, or a key without the admin scope

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

post.summary: Creates a key and returns its secret, once.

201.description: The new key, with its secret

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

delete.summary: Revokes a key. Revoked keys are refused with 401 from then on.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace or live key, or no access

get.summary: Identity conflicts, newest first: those still open (the default) or already resolved.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before of the previous page

400.description: status or limit is out of range, or before is malformed

403.description: A key with neither the read nor the admin scope

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

get.summary:
One conflict and the identities of its two people. Values are shown to the owner,
workspace admins and `admin` keys, and masked for everyone else.

200.description: The conflict with both people's identities

403.description: A key with neither the read nor the admin scope

404.description: No such workspace or conflict, or no access

post.summary:
Closes an open conflict: keep the two people separate, or move the shared identifier to
one of them. There is no unmerge. Audited as `identity_conflict.kept_separate` or
`identity_conflict.identifier_moved`, and recorded as an `identity.conflict.resolved`
decision.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace or conflict, or no access

409.description: Already resolved, the move would break an identity rule, or the people changed since the conflict was loaded (detail starts with `conflict_changed`)

422.description: to_person_id is not one of the conflict's two people

get.summary: The members of a workspace. Any member can read this.

403.description: The API key lacks the read or admin scope

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

put.summary: Adds a user to the workspace or changes their role. Workspace admins and the owner only.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace or user, or no access

delete.summary: Removes a user from the workspace. Workspace admins and the owner only.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace or member, or no access

get.summary:
What was decided and done under one trace, in the workspace. A trace with no records in
this workspace is 404, whether or not it exists elsewhere.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: Trace id: 32 lowercase hex characters, from the x-trace-id response header

403.description: The API key lacks the read scope

404.description: No such workspace, no access to it, or no records for the trace in it

get.summary: The workspace's field registry, archived definitions included.

403.description: A key without the read scope

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace, or no access to it

422.description: Invalid key, type, precedence or other field

patch.summary: Changes the mutable fields of a trait. The type is not one of them.

403.description: Not a workspace admin, a missing scope, or a missing CSRF token

404.description: No such workspace or trait, or no access

422.description: An invalid field, no field at all, or an attempt to change the type

get.summary: Liveness: the process is serving requests. Never touches the database.
Readiness: the database is reachable and its schema is up to date.

503.description: The database is unreachable or its schema is not up to date

id.description: What caused the work: a request id for `api`, otherwise a record id.

kind.description: The identifier kind the two people share, such as `email`.

other_person_id.description: The other person that owns the shared identifier.

person_id.description: The person the record attached to.

reason.description:
Why the people were not merged: `unique_kind`, `max_per_person`, or `merge_deferred`
on conflicts recorded before merges existed.

people.description:
The conflict's person first, then the other person; one entry when they have since
been merged into one.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null when there is none.

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter; at most 64.

source_order.description: Source names in priority order, for `source_priority`.

type.description:
One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `timestamp`, `date`, `string_list`. It cannot
be changed later: archive the key and create a new one.

slug.description: `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, up to 63 characters. Derived from the name when omitted.

key.description:
The full key (`zfk_...`) to send as `Authorization: Bearer`. Shown once; only a hash
of its secret is stored.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null when there is none.

subject_ids.description: Durable domain ids by name; never personal data.

shared.description: The identifier the conflict is about.

value.description: Null when `masked`: only workspace admins, the owner and `admin` keys see values.

dead_at.description: When the job went dead; null once retried.

state.description: `dead` in the list; `ready` after a retry.

trace_id.description: The trace the job belongs to: 32 lowercase hex characters.

oldest_ready_seconds.description: How long the longest-waiting runnable job has waited; null when none is runnable.

local.description: True when e-mail and password sign-in is accepted.

oidc.description: True when sign-in through the identity provider is configured.

trace_id.description:
The `x-trace-id` of the failed request; look it up with
`GET /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/traces/{trace_id}`.

type.description: Problem type URI; `about:blank` until specific types are defined.

oneOf.description: The two people are different people; the identifier stays where it is.
The shared identifier belongs to `to_person_id`, one of the conflict's two people.

csrf_token.description: Send this as `x-csrf-token` on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE made with the cookie.

token.description: The setup token the server logged at startup. Absent counts as wrong.

required.description: True only while no owner exists.

trace_id.description: The trace id: 32 lowercase hex characters.

truncated.description: True when the trace has more records than this response carries.

inferred.description: Registered automatically from an incoming record rather than created by a person.

source_order.description: Source names in priority order; used by `source_priority`.

UserBody.description: A user as shown to API callers; never includes the password hash.

api_key.description: Workspace API key (zfk_...). Valid only for its own workspace and within its scopes.

session.name: zf_session
session.description: Session cookie set by POST /api/v1/session. Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE              made with it must also send the CSRF token in the x-csrf-token header.
